editorial:
Imagine returning to work after a year away, only to find your love life in total chaos. That is exactly what happens to Haruta in this wild ride. You get to see him reunite with his old boss, Kurosawa, and his partner, Maki, but things are not as simple as they used to be. The vibe is a mix of loud comedy and sweet romance, making you laugh out loud one minute and feel for the characters the next. With a new recruit named Justice entering the mix and a fancy corporate team shaking things up, the energy stays high. It feels like a big, messy family reunion where everyone is fighting for the same person's heart.

What really makes this work is the over-the-top acting; the characters express their feelings with so much passion that it becomes hilarious. The plot twist involving Kurosawa's memory loss adds a great layer of drama without slowing down the pace too much. While the story can feel a bit crowded with so many love interests, the heart of the movie always shines through. If you want a feel-good movie that doesn't take itself too seriously, you should definitely check this out. It looks great streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a huge fan, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: After all the fighting and confusion, Haruta finally makes a clear choice. He realizes that his heart belongs to Kurosawa, regardless of the memory loss or the other suitors. Kurosawa recovers his feelings, and the two of them officially commit to each other. The movie wraps up with a heartwarming scene where they accept their love in front of their colleagues, leaving the other rivals defeated but happy for them. It is a happy, sunny ending for everyone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with a lot of energy and emotional twists.
